title: A boy discovers his grandmother's secret during a summer on an island
title_candidates: A French director made an AI film about the last giant on earth
The AI film series about a boy and the world's last living giant
How a real director turned AI video tools into a full cinematic series
What an AI series looks like when a director with real skills makes it
The AI film following the last giant alive, shot entirely without a camera
caption:
A French filmmaker built a full cinematic series called La Nona Gigante using AI video generation. It follows a boy who spends a summer with his grandmother, the last living giant on her island. The scale of what one person made without a crew, a budget, or a single camera is genuinely hard to process.

A few years ago this needed a studio and months of post-production. Now a director with a vision can build it alone. That gap is closing faster than most people realize.
